title: APS doesn't not respond to BG readings
symptom: BG is changing every 5 min but APS doesn't run sometimes for 25 min, requiring pressing 'run now' to act accordingly. The issue recurs despite reinstalling the app.
cause: MilosKozak identified that the problem is no BG data reaching AAPS, possibly due to sensor out of range or sleeping Dexcom app.
fix: No definitive fix was provided; MilosKozak suggested turning off AUTOSENS logging to get better logs, and the user was asked to provide logs from the right period. The issue remained unresolved.
evidence_quote: I see execution 17:23:46 and then new BG @17:33:37 so your problem is no BG data. It can be sensor out of range or sleeping Dexcom app
